# Pump OÜ — Grundfos pumps in Estonia

> Pump OÜ is an Estonian Grundfos pump retailer. The catalogue covers heating, hot-water circulation, borewell, drainage, pressure boosting, sewage and other water-pumping applications. Product pages show VAT-inclusive consumer prices, availability and technical details.

## Crawling guidance

- Canonical URLs and alternate-language links are included in page metadata.
- The XML sitemap is available at https://pumbapood.ee/sitemap.xml.
- Use product detail pages as the authoritative source for current price, availability and specifications.
- Prices displayed to consumers and exposed in product structured data include Estonian VAT.
